purpose: Compare frozen leave-one-record predictions from revision (v1), revision_v2, and revision_v3.
claim_scope: Diagnostic comparison only; it does not establish successful prediction or select a winner.
processing: Measured curves are Q1-cleaned and per-trial baseline corrected. v1/v2 cue-only predictions were post-processed with the common Q1 0.2-24 Hz fourth-order zero-phase filter, 256-to-128 Hz resampling, and per-channel -200..0 ms baseline. v3 predictions were already processed with this operator.
fit_policy: No refitting. v1 predictions were read from saved NPZ; v2 curves were regenerated from saved held-out fit parameters only; v3 predictions were read from saved CSV.
comparability_limit: v1/v2 parameters and gains were originally fit under their own objectives; applying a common observation operator afterward standardizes the plotted output but does not make the original training objectives identical. v3_round1 uses a different chronological-block split and full-event context and is not included.
